question: Are antibody-epitope windows on neuronal/synaptic IDP parents enriched for free-state transient structure (lower flexibility) relative to exposure-matched, structurally-unprecedented windows of the same parents?

case_windows.definition: epitope windows of C0 valid families mapped onto parent sequences, plus ESEL E0b anchored rows

parent_anchoring_rules.anchored: parent peptide is a contiguous substring of the UniProt sequence
parent_anchoring_rules.anchored_with_mismatch: RCSB entity names the accession AND the peptide differs from the UniProt sequence by <=1 substitution in a <=20-residue peptide AND the entry title names the parent protein; every mismatch is recorded per window and the family is flagged

case_windows.pre_data_note: tau GSVQIVYKPK is expected to require anchored_with_mismatch (canonical tau carries VQIVYKPVL at the homologous segment; the deposited peptide reads GSVQIVYKPK per the VHH Z70 entry) - this rule is frozen before any label read

control_windows.definition: same parent, same window length, exposure-matched, and without structural precedent within the local evidence universe
control_windows.exposure_metric: mean per-residue CA SASA of the window computed on the bound antigen chain of the deposited complex (Bio.PDB.SASA ShrakeRupley); bound-state exposure is a proxy - the free-state limitation is disclosed
control_windows.precedent_universe: the local sabdab2 projected pool (1,146 CIFs) sweep plus the 28-component queue; NOT an exhaustive SAbDab search - disclosed limitation
control_windows.iedb_role: protein-level IEDB metadata counts are recorded as covariates only; window-level IEDB precedent is NOT obtainable at metadata level and is never claimed

label_ladder.primary: ATLAS MD RMSF (per-residue mean over replicates; cache-first)
label_ladder.secondary: NMR ensemble RMSF v2 (results/flex_a2_nmr_rmsf_v2, corrected Kabsch)
label_ladder.downgraded_fallback: AFDB pLDDT tracks (results/flex_a2_atlas_plddt_audit_v1) - disorder proxy, not flexibility; recorded as downgraded and never pooled with RMSF labels

label_strata.primary_stratum: parents whose case window carries an ATLAS or NMR v2 RMSF label (pre-data count: 3 - alpha-syn P37840 via 2kkw NMR v2; gp160 P04578 and spike P0DTC2 via ATLAS); the primary endpoint is computed ON THIS STRATUM ONLY
label_strata.downgraded_stratum: parents with AFDB pLDDT only (expected 6): descriptive-only, reported separately, never pooled with the primary stratum
label_strata.stratum_note: different label types are different quantities; pooling would fabricate coverage, so the strata are frozen here before any label read

environmental_notes.peptide_search_unavailable: UniProt peptide-search asyncrest submits (202 + Location) but the poll returned empty for >=90 s on 2026-11-08 for a known-positive control peptide (KEDAFSKLKEKFMNEL, contained in P21579); the fallback path is recorded unavailable, not zero-evidence
environmental_notes.unresolved_rows: 6i2g, 8skj, 6zwk remain unresolved and are excluded from the C1 universe; tau 8op0/8opi/8pii anchor via anchored_with_mismatch to P10636

endpoint.metric: parent-level paired difference: mean window RMSF(case) - mean window RMSF(control)

stop_rules.label_starvation: parents with case + control + label coverage < 3 -> freeze verdict label_starvation; downgrade to AFDB pLDDT or report and stop (E0 precedent)
stop_rules.iedb_unavailable: structural-only case definition with a recorded downgrade note

red_lines: IEDB access stays metadata-level: counts and query strings only
no model scores anywhere in C1 selection or scoring
no cross-citation with frozen ECLS/PAE/J0 results
enrichment describes window properties; no disease-mechanism or design claim
claims_boundary: C1 tests a population-level association between antibody precedent and free-state transient structure on neuronal IDP parents. It does not establish why antibodies bind where they bind, does not predict immunogenicity, and does not support any design or clinical claim.
